context: Tests whether the agent correctly uses checkpoint:["fill"] combined with !checkpoint:["formsubmit"] to identify form abandonment, uses --facet-values fill.source to enumerate touched fields, and uses --series formBlockLoadTime for form performance — applying negation only on the checkpoint facet (which supports it) and not attempting negation on fill.source (which does not).

checklist.name: checkpoint fill for form interactions
checklist.description: The abandonment query includes checkpoint:["fill"] in its --query filter

checklist.name: Negation for no-submit
checklist.description: The abandonment query uses !checkpoint:["formsubmit"] to exclude sessions where the form was submitted

checklist.name: Negation on checkpoint only
checklist.description: Negation (!) is applied to checkpoint, not to fill.source or any other facet that does not support negation

checklist.name: facet-values fill.source for field enumeration
checklist.description: The field enumeration query uses --facet-values fill.source (not a filter query) to discover which form fields are being filled

checklist.name: formBlockLoadTime series
checklist.description: The form performance query includes --series formBlockLoadTime

checklist.name: No series on abandonment query
checklist.description: The form abandonment count query does NOT include a --series flag

checklist.name: url filter on contact page
checklist.description: At least one query includes a url filter scoped to the contact page

checklist.name: Dynamic dates, 14-day range
checklist.description: Dates are computed dynamically using shell date commands and span 14 days ending yesterday
